invariants: Only workspace modules imported with the frozen callable enter its retained module mapping.
Runtime module lookup receives the exact module objects used to construct the callable.
Invocation restores every replaced module entry and removes every temporarily added entry.
The existing file-access observer continues to reject undeclared data-file reads.

mechanical_evidence.codeql_selection: 4 selected tests; 1 deferred integration test; no fallback domains; no incomplete declarations

tradeoffs.runtime: One bounded module-dictionary installation and restoration occurs per stage invocation.
tradeoffs.memory: The worker retains references to modules it already imported until that single-stage worker exits.

exclusions: A stage that imports a new workspace module for the first time during its governed call still requires an explicit source or input boundary.
The full integration and distribution suites remain session-closure gates.
